scope: Four new-build raw ResidualCNN L1 baseline screenshots only; actual view_image visual inspection, separate batch. A byte-size difference between PAPER85 and PAPER180 is recorded as a file fact and was not treated as stale evidence; expanded Blocks contour is visibly present in both.
reviewer: Codex subagent /root/boundary_matrix_pixel_audit; automated actual-pixel review, not human researcher or publication reviewer

environmentScope.screenshots: Every reviewed raw image is 1280 x 720; current DOM viewport individually cross-checked.
environmentScope.userAgent: Earlier same selected IAB observation, as explicitly marked in per-case environmentProvenance; current UA remains unobserved.
environmentScope.currentEnvironmentFile: Not used to generalize its earlier 1102 x 835 state across captures.

limitations: Raw screenshots were actually opened and visually inspected; no pass inferred from helper/status/metadata.
Pixel inspection supports visible contour, selected controls, clipping/modal absence and style, not canonical endpoint or shared/repeat correctness.
Deep-fit tiny labels cannot establish per-node/port/legend readability at publication size.
Physical 85/180 mm readability, real human acceptance, export paint fidelity and presented performance are unverified.
Hash stability links the files reviewed; it does not independently certify screenshot provenance.

cases.method: tools.view_image once for this exact raw screenshot at 1280 by 720 native-file size; AI visual reviewer, not human participant/publication reviewer

pixelObservations.frontierContour: Image and stem lead into expanded Blocks container with two visible collapsed ResidualBlock1 and ResidualBlock2 cards, then pool, flatten, classifier and output in a vertical chain; corresponding two children are visible in left tree. Outer residual route remains visible.
pixelObservations.textReadability: Stage and ResidualBlock labels readable in 85 preview and visible in 180 preview; fine ports/parameters/physical publication readability not certified.
pixelObservations.captureConsistency: The 85 and 180 PAPER screenshots differ in JPEG byte size and mild sharpness/background rendering, but both visibly show the L1 expanded Blocks contour and their corresponding page headers; no stale L0 contour observed.

cases.result: Visible L1 expanded Blocks contour, controls and full-paper/legend framing match named baseline; no modal/clipping. The differing file size is preserved as capture metadata, not used to infer a state mismatch.
